cases.name: sumNat
cases.definition: def sumNat : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | n+1 => sumNat n + (n+1)

cases.name: sumOdd
cases.definition: def sumOdd : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | n+1 => sumOdd n + (2*n+1)

cases.name: sumCube
cases.definition: def sumCube : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | n+1 => sumCube n + (n+1)^3

cases.name: fact
cases.definition: def fact : Nat → Nat | 0 => 1 | n+1 => (n+1)*fact n

cases.name: revAcc
cases.definition: def revAcc : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat | [], a => a | x::xs, a => revAcc xs (x::a)

cases.name: fib
cases.definition: def fib : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | 1 => 1 | n+2 => fib (n+1) + fib n

cases.name: prime
cases.definition: def prime (p : Nat) : Prop := 2 ≤ p ∧ ∀ d : Nat, d ∣ p → d = 1 ∨ d = p
cases.positive: 2 ≤ n → ∃ p : Nat, prime p ∧ p ∣ n ∧ ∀ d : Nat, 2 ≤ d → d ∣ n → p ≤ d
cases.negative: 2 ≤ n → ∃ p : Nat, prime p ∧ p ∣ n ∧ p < n

cases.name: euclid
cases.positive: euclid a b ∣ a ∧ euclid a b ∣ b
cases.negative: euclid a b ∣ a ∧ euclid a b ∣ b ∧ euclid a b = 1

cases.name: sort
cases.definition:
def ins (x : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat | [] => [x] | y::ys => if x ≤ y then x::y::ys else y::ins x ys
def sort : List Nat → List Nat | [] => [] | x::xs => ins x (sort xs)

rules: No solutions or counterexamples sent to provider; evaluator only.
No changes after execution begins; amendments require new version.
Retain every candidate, raw diagnostic, hashes, timestamps, model identifier, token usage if available, and terminal outcome.
Negative target rejection alone is not proof of falsity; validate counterexamples separately.
Report unsupported targets and missing cost telemetry, never count them as success.
No benchmark execution until all definitions and statements elaborate and negative controls are validated.
Lemma discovery measured only when verified auxiliary lemmas are used in accepted root proof.
